metadata.short_desc: Relay AstrBot group chats to the Alkaid0 coding agent.
metadata.desc: Hands AstrBot messages to the Alkaid0 coding agent: registers the alkaid0 runner, keeps one ACP v2 (WebSocket) connection and session per group, reclaims idle connections, and auto-installs the two prerequisite plugins (astrbot_plugin_librunner / astrbot_plugin_libi18nject) at startup.

enforce_prerequisite.description: Enforce prerequisite plugins (disable this plugin if missing)
enforce_prerequisite.hint: This plugin depends on astrbot_plugin_librunner (runner injection) and astrbot_plugin_libi18nject (WebUI text injection). When enabled, startup checks both prerequisites, installs missing ones with gh/git clone and activates them in place without restarting AstrBot. If installation fails, this plugin is disabled and the reason appears under failed plugins. When disabled, the plugin still starts without the prerequisites (some features may be unavailable).

prerequisite_librunner_repo.hint: GitHub owner/repo or a full git URL used to install astrbot_plugin_librunner (useful for mirrors or intranet hosts). Only used when the prerequisite is missing and enforcement is enabled.

prerequisite_libi18nject_repo.hint: GitHub owner/repo or a full git URL used to install astrbot_plugin_libi18nject (useful for mirrors or intranet hosts). It is a prerequisite of librunner and is installed first.

acp_url.hint: For example ws://127.0.0.1:7433/acp?key=<key> (authentication uses the key query parameter). This is only the fallback: values in the runner panel (AI → Agent execution → Alkaid0) take precedence.

workspace_template.hint: One working directory per group. Supports {groupid} (group ID, or session ID in private chats), {sessionid} and {platform}; unknown placeholders are kept as-is. The template root (the part before the first placeholder) must already exist on the Alkaid0 side; rendered subdirectories are created automatically (fs/mkdir). The runner panel takes precedence.

idle_timeout_sec.hint: After this much inactivity, close the group's ACP session and disconnect; the next message resumes the recorded session (no history replay). 0 disables automatic reclaim. The runner panel takes precedence.

turn_timeout_sec.hint: How long to wait for state_update idle after submitting a prompt; exceeding it is reported as an error. The runner panel takes precedence.

echo_events.description: Echo progress events (tool calls / sub-agents / background tasks)
echo_events.hint: Send Alkaid0 progress events to the chat: tool calls (with status and background task ID), sub-agent switches, and background task completion. Each status is sent once; streaming previews are not echoed. When disabled, only the final answer is sent (tool approval prompts are not affected). The runner panel takes precedence.

show_thought.hint: When enabled, agent_thought(_chunk) updates are sent as reasoning message chains. The runner panel takes precedence.

auto_approve_enable.hint: Master switch for tool approvals. When disabled, session/request_permission is always deferred until someone sends /aapprove. When enabled, approvals may pass through the configured whitelist, prompt grants, or external hook grants. The runner panel value takes precedence.

auto_approve_tools.hint: Separated by commas / spaces / newlines, case-insensitive, supports * and ? wildcards; a single * means every tool. Empty means no tools are approved by the config layer. The runner panel value takes precedence.

auto_approve_prompt.hint: When enabled, a chat message containing [auto_approve: read, edit] approves those tools for this turn only; [auto_approve] alone approves every tool for this turn. The marker is removed before the prompt is sent. The master switch still applies.

auto_approve_hook.hint: When enabled, /wakeup and other external entry points may pass auto_approve (true or a tool list) to approve only that external turn. The master switch still applies.

wakeup_enable.hint: The wake-up endpoint reuses AstrBot's own Web port (/api/v1/plugins/extensions/astrbot_plugin_0528_v2/wakeup); no extra port is opened. It accepts a session ID, resumes every conversation bound to that session and only answers once the connections have actually received this turn's updates. A one-click install turns this switch on.

wakeup_api_key.hint: Leave empty to rely on AstrBot's own API key (recommended; the one-click install creates one). If set, callers must also send X-0528V2-Key (or ?plugin_key=); the value is written into the hook command in plain text as well. Click one-click install again after changing it.

wakeup_public_url.description: Public URL of the wake-up hook (optional)
wakeup_public_url.hint: Set this when alkaid0 runs on another host or in a container, e.g. http://172.17.0.1:6185. Leave empty to derive it from AstrBot's own bind address and port (0.0.0.0 becomes 127.0.0.1).

wakeup_wait_sec.description: Seconds to wait for message delivery
wakeup_wait_sec.hint: How long the HTTP call may wait until the connections really receive this turn's content (user_message / agent_message, ...). On timeout it returns 504 and alkaid0 logs the hook as failed.

wakeup_relay_reply.description: Relay the cron turn's reply to the chat
wakeup_relay_reply.hint: When enabled, the reply of the cron-triggered turn (plus progress lines when echo_events is on) is sent to every conversation bound to the session; tool approvals are announced there as well. Disable to only wake and receive notifications without sending anything.

wakeup_auto_approve.description: Auto-approved tools for the cron hook
wakeup_auto_approve.hint: Empty disables passthrough. Use * to approve every tool for cron turns, or a comma/space separated tool list. It is appended to the installed alkaid0 hook command as the auto_approve query parameter. The Auto-Approve master switch and external-hook permission still apply. Click one-click install again after changing it.

settings.title: Plugin settings
settings.description: Browse and edit this plugin's AstrBot settings. For alkaid0's global config, open the "Alkaid0 global settings" view.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prerequisites.description: Manage the two prerequisite plugins: librunner (runner injection) and libi18nject (WebUI text).

connection.title: Connection and timeouts
connection.description: Alkaid0 ACP URL, group idle reclaim and per-turn timeout.

workspace.title: Working directory
workspace.description: One working directory per group; supports {groupid} / {sessionid} / {platform} placeholders.

chat.title: Chat echo
chat.description: Control whether progress events and reasoning are sent to the chat.

auto_approve.title: Tool approval passthrough
auto_approve.description: Auto-approve tool requests from the configured whitelist, prompt grants, or external hooks; everything else still waits for /aapprove.

other.title: Other
other.description: Configuration items that are not grouped yet.

wakeup.title: Wake-up hook (cronjob)
wakeup.description: Expose a wake-up endpoint on AstrBot's own Web port for alkaid0's cron wake-up hook. Writing it into alkaid0 requires clicking one-click install.

hook.title: alkaid0 cron wake-up hook
hook.description: Only the buttons change alkaid0's configuration (saving the settings above does not sync automatically). One-click install also creates an AstrBot API key, writes it into the hook command in plain text and turns the wake-up switch on; click it again after changing the URL / secret.
hook.not_ready: The wake-up hook is disabled. Turn the switch above on, save, then click one-click install.
hook.done_install: Installed: the API key was created and the hook was written into alkaid0.
hook.done_remove: Removed: the hook and the API key were cleaned up.
hook.failed: Sync failed; check the status below or the AstrBot logs.
